cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(GBA-Emulator VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

# Route autogenerated files into the build directory, not the source tree
set(CMAKE_AUTOGEN_SOURCE_GROUP "Autogen")
set(CMAKE_AUTOGEN_BUILD_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/autogen")


# Use C++20 standard
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# MSVC: Ensure __cplusplus macro is properly set
if (MSVC)
    add_compile_options(/Zc:__cplusplus)
endif()

# FetchContent inclusion - required for googletest
include(FetchContent)

#Find SDL3 package
if(NOT DEFINED ENV{SDL3_DIR})
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Please set SDL3_DIR environment variable")
endif()

set(CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH "$ENV{SDL3_DIR}" CACHE PATH "SDL3 path")
find_package(SDL3 REQUIRED CONFIG REQUIRED COMPONENTS SDL3-shared)

#Find Qt package
if(NOT DEFINED ENV{Qt_DIR})
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Please set Qt_DIR environment variable")
endif()

set(CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH "$ENV{Qt_DIR}" CACHE PATH "Qt path")
find_package(Qt6 6.9 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Widgets Gui Qml Quick QuickControls2)

qt_standard_project_setup()

# Create main executable
qt_add_executable(GBA-Emulator main.cpp)

# Add include directory
target_include_directories(GBA-Emulator PUBLIC ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)

# Link to Qt and SDL3
target_link_libraries(GBA-Emulator PRIVATE 
    GBAQtUI
)

# Google test
FetchContent_Declare(
  googletest
  URL https://github.com/google/googletest/archive/03597a01ee50ed33e9dfd640b249b4be3799d395.zip
)

# For Windows: Prevent overriding the parent project's compiler/linker settings
set(gtest_force_shared_crt ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(googletest)

# Add the subdirectories for source, include, and lib files
add_subdirectory(src)
add_subdirectory(testing)
add_subdirectory(lib)
add_subdirectory(qt_ui)

# CPack testing
include(CTest)
enable_testing()

set(CPACK_PROJECT_NAME ${PROJECT_NAME})
set(CPACK_PROJECT_VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION})
include(CPack)
